title: P2RLN Passive Web Content Profile
description: Defines passive HTML/CSS-based educational representations without arbitrary executable JavaScript dependencies.
rules: Representations MUST identify this profile with their profile URI.
HTML representations MUST NOT require arbitrary executable JavaScript under this profile.
Referenced embedded resources MUST be inventoried in the manifest.
Deliverers SHOULD target WCAG 2.2 AA for authored web content.
A multi-file passive web representation MAY declare https://p2rln.org/extension/web-content-bundle using mapping version 1.
A web-content bundle mapping MUST identify one safe relative entrypoint and a complete logical-path to inventoried embedded-payload map.
Reading Systems MUST NOT treat package HTML as permission to execute arbitrary JavaScript or fetch undeclared package assets.
Reading Systems that support relative bundle assets SHOULD resolve them through a host-controlled virtual resource bridge rather than rewriting the portable graph.
